record.title: R63 relief-capital allocation learning
record.body: Durable learning: dependency relief is not manufacturing yield. Allocation requires clean exact-current evidence, replay, qualification receipt, falsifier, generated projection, positive relief, non-zero actionable opportunity yield, consumer/evidence-root breadth, and coherent request->execution->receipt->relief ordering. Historical independence machinery must be reconstituted onto current canonical main rather than merged from a deeply diverged lineage.
